sources.locator: configuration parsing format list; API request; documentation/branch/implementation plan request
sources.quotation: Valve configuration files, json, csv, tsv, ini, xml, yaml, toml; precise memory control; plan an api for each format; document that, create a branch for this, and plan complete implementation
SIRCore, allocator callbacks and memory manager exist; no configuration parsing subsystem
editor source and deterministic cooked records are separate responsibilities

requirements.statement: Support JSON, CSV, TSV, INI, XML, YAML and TOML
Support Valve KeyValues 1/VDF, KV3 and console CFG through distinct APIs
Publish an API for each format, with common IO, errors and ownership
Precise control of parser allocations and memory budgets
Evaluate libucl rather than assume it fits; pin audited parser dependencies
Bounded parsing and no implicit code execution, file or network effects
Integrate native SIREngine C++17 CMake build and tests
Complete implementation includes conformance, unit, fuzz and performance testing
Explicit deterministic cooked configuration support for runtime
Preserve editable-source semantics when editor consumers exist
